meta.name: before-you-build
meta.description: Pre-build product and feature risk review for founders, product managers, and AI-assisted builders. Use this skill when the user is about to build a landing page, MVP, SaaS product, internal tool, agent workflow, or major feature and needs to check demand, positioning, monetization, retention, trust, distribution, and adoption risk before implementation starts.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你：是创始人或产品经理，想在投入开发前确认想法是否靠谱。
copy.tagline_en: Check product risks before you build
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're a founder or PM validating a product idea before development.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会在你动手做之前跑一次简短预检,围绕需求、定位、变现等风险给出结论:风险等级(低/中/高)、最可能出问题的假设、该先找的证据、下一步做什么、暂时别做什么。
howto.when: 当你要做新产品、MVP、落地页等准备上线的东西,或影响不明的大功能时触发;窄范围的修 bug、重构、更新依赖不触发。

say.text: 我准备做一个面向独立开发者的记账 SaaS,先帮我做上线前风险预检
say.note: 会给出风险等级、主要假设和下一步

say.text: 这个内部工具的定位和变现路径风险高吗?
say.note: 会指出最可能出问题的那一条

say.text: 动手之前,哪个假设最该先验证?
say.note: 会给出最小的验证步骤和该暂缓的部分

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude runs a short pre-mortem before you build: a risk verdict (low/medium/high), the riskiest assumption, the smallest evidence to gather first, the next validation step, and what to delay.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you're about to build a product, MVP, landing page, SaaS app, internal tool, or major feature. Skips narrow bug fixes, refactors, dependency updates, or already-validated changes.

say_en.text: About to build a bookkeeping SaaS for indie devs — run a pre-build risk review.
say_en.note: Returns the risk verdict, main assumption, next step.

say_en.text: Is the positioning and monetization path risky for this internal tool?
say_en.note: Names the most likely breaking assumption.

say_en.text: What's the one assumption I should validate first?
say_en.note: Gives the smallest validation step and what to delay.
